body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Suppress one Light Wound Condition's numerical penalties until the start of your next turn. The target also gains +1 Composure against pain during that time.

surges.html: Extend suppression through the end of your next turn.
Also suppress one ordinary Poison penalty for the same duration.

rider.title: Strain - Barrier
rider.html: If you accepted Strain, the target may move 1 unit when it next suffers Damage before your next turn, after the Damage resolves.
